text: Harness engineering is a sign of how fast terms evolve.

text: So what do I mean by loops?

text: What are the loops that you might be working on?
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: There are three core concepts.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Each maps to a certain phase of development.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So you have your inner loop.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Which is as the coding agent is working on a PR before it has put it up.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So these are very fast iterative loops.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: You want them to be cheap.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: You're expecting the agent to run them all the time.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Improvements here will drive better autonomy.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: They help catch things and correct the agent without your coming in in human intervention.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Once the PR is up, you move to the outer loop.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So this is where you're going to put more expensive, exhaustive checks that don't make sense to run over and over again as the agent is iterating on features.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: But they do encode things that otherwise a human would have to verify to build confidence in the system.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And so this is because they're more expensive, but they are taking away human review time that can be worth it.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So this is where you might put something like agentic QA or where you might say like run mutation testing to check the quality of our test suite.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: This is for expensive things you want to run once when the PR goes up and then have the agent iterate on the results.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Finally, you have the meta loop.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: This is where you'll drive quality.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So the meta loop sits outside of the development process.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: It observes your coding agent logs.

text: It looks at PRs, your issue tracker, user feedback.

text: And it's basically finding mistakes that are making their way through the pipeline to your users or that you had to correct as a human to stop that from happening.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And it feeds back into the inner and the outer loop to make sure that that mistake is not made again.
